edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-93 on printed pp. 1025-1115, followed on p. 1115 by the promulgation formula, date, and beginning of the subscriptions. Subscriptions and notarial attestations continue through printed p. 1120.
edition.title: Constitutio pastoralis de Ecclesia in mundo huius temporis Gaudium et spes

passages.context: The Constitution's complete numbered Latin body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 1025 and ending with article 93 on printed p. 1115 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-93 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

alternate_titles: Constitutio pastoralis de Ecclesia in mundo huius temporis
Pastoral Constitution on the Church in the Modern World
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Pastoral Constitution on the Church in the Modern World, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 7 December 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-93; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Gaudium et spes
